units.title: Sequences & Series
units.blurb: Arithmetic and geometric sequences, their sums, and infinite geometric series.

units.title: Trigonometry & the Unit Circle
units.blurb: Radians, the unit circle, special angles, sine and cosine waves and their transformations.

units.title: Complex Numbers
units.blurb: The imaginary unit, arithmetic in a + bi form, conjugates and division, and complex roots.

units.title: Statistics & Data
